reviews.title: Just what I needed
reviews.comment: Just what I needed for recording on a Galaxy S25 Ultra. The sound quality is much better then the phones mic. I record a lot of live music and this little guy can handle up to 115 db. Very happy...
reviews.author: SR

reviews.title: Only buy if you want worse sound quality than you’d get with just your phone
reviews.comment: Honestly pretty disappointed in this product. The sound quality using it is WORSE than if I just used my Iphone 16Pro so I would not recommend. The USB-C aspect didn’t fit into my phone well so we had to literally flip my phone upside down if I wanted to connect it so it’s very inconvenient. It’s also very bulky and not discrete and impossible to film with with a case on and without using a tripod. Not satisfied
reviews.author: Joni
